<VAST_SKILLS>
These VAST-CoEvo skills are declarative guidance. Existing system instructions, tool permissions, customer identity, exact write grants and budgets retain priority. <VAST_SKILL id="refund_settlement_authorization" version="1" type="decision" content_hash="c12012049b23700d998323aed90b1dbb3fe253274231761520c31b7b26c41492">
{
  "content_hash": "c12012049b23700d998323aed90b1dbb3fe253274231761520c31b7b26c41492",
  "description": "Ensures refund and settlement operations have explicit current customer consent before execution. Verifies that each distinct write operation has separate authorization and that return-required settlements have independent receipt attestation.",
  "id": "refund_settlement_authorization",
  "postconditions": [
    "Settlement operations executed only with explicit current customer consent for the specific operation",
    "Return-required refunds verified to have independent receipt attestation before settlement",
    "Each distinct write operation has separate customer authorization"
  ],
  "preconditions": [
    "A refund or settlement operation is being considered for execution",
    "Customer has previously requested a remedy for an order line"
  ],
  "procedure": [
    "Identify the specific settlement operation being attempted (e.g., release_refund, commit_resolution)",
    "Verify that exact current customer consent exists for this specific operation with matching parameters",
    "Check if the quote requires_return is true",
    "If requires_return is true, verify that return has been received with independent attestation in the case returns array",
    "Confirm that customer consent statement explicitly names the operation and matches current quote details",
    "Do not execute the settlement operation unless all authorization checks pass",
    "If consent is missing or does not match the current operation, halt and request explicit consent"
  ],
  "recovery": [
    "If explicit consent for the settlement operation is missing, present the exact operation details and quote to the customer",
    "Request explicit customer consent stating the specific operation name and parameters",
    "Wait for customer to provide explicit consent before proceeding with settlement",
    "Do not assume that consent for one operation (e.g., schedule_return) authorizes subsequent operations (e.g., release_refund)"
  ],
  "schema_version": 1,
  "scope": {
    "domains": [
      "aftersales"
    ],
    "tools": []
  },
  "trigger": {
    "intents": [],
    "keywords": [
      "refund",
      "settlement",
      "release"
    ]
  },
  "type": "decision",
  "version": 1
}
</VAST_SKILL>
</VAST_SKILLS>
